note: Per-hull, speed-keyed normal-turn integer table for Community Edition 2.670. Same shape as docs/rules/data/het.json (hulls, speedPoints, interpolation, rounding, audit.expect / audit.tolerances). All sim table entries are integers with no floats. Rates are 16-bit angle units per tick (65536 = full turn) at 30 Hz. Durations are integer ticks. Optional integer speedHundredths (speed × 100) is the interpolation key so a measured half-speed point can be stored without a float; when omitted, interpolation uses speed × 100.

interpolation.note: Between adjacent speed points, linearly interpolate in fixed-point integer math (no floats) on speedHundredths using the same rulesDiv / interpInt rounding as data/het.json; clamp speeds below the first point or above the last point to the nearest endpoint. Delay is a per-hull constant in this table (not observed to vary with speed).

rounding.workedExample: 8 deg/s = 48.545... -> 49 integer angle units per tick at 30 Hz; 1.45 s -> 44 ticks

hullOrderNote: Stable sim ids: engine/sim numbers hull rows by their position in this list, so append new hull keys at the end. Every key under hulls must be listed. default is the row for hulls with no entry of their own. Editing a row's speedPoints needs no code change.

F-CA.note: CE Tier-1 in-battle capture (Wintermute, 2026-11-24) reconciled with Tier-2 10-90% capture (2026-11-24). Kept the denser Tier-1 game-clock-normalized curve (4, 7, 8, 10, 13, 14, 20, 25, 29.5, including the real 13-20 dip) and added the Tier-2 speed-5 point (4.70 deg/s -> 29 units/tick, matching Tier-1 linear interpolation 4.73 deg/s / 29 within 0.03 deg/s). Tier-2 single-run 10-90% readings at 10 (7.41 vs 7.8, -0.39) and 20 (8.20 vs 7.6, +0.60) fall outside the +-0.3 Tier-1 tolerance and are kept as TO VERIFY rather than overwriting the multi-run game-clock curve.
